product.title: The Secret Waterfall Private tour with photos

description.text: This private tour gets you closer to some of the most stunning waterfalls on Kauai than would be possible alone or in a big group. The exact location depends upon your party's preferences and abilities but the tour can be as challenging as you wish. Stops include Secret Waterfall, Kauai Rainforest Trail, Rainforest Lookout. Your guide is a professional photographer and videographer so you will have someone with you to capture memories to cherish. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
